pg_analyze_p: Turn your field conditions into a smarter crop decision.
pg_region_p: Typical values for an Indian agro-climatic zone — not live sensors.
pg_crop_p: Average soil and climate for a crop. Enter a soil test when you have one.
pg_analyze_note: Live ESP32 fill waits for hardware. Region presets are typical values, not your field.
pg_hint_n: Leaf growth. Low N often shows as yellowing.
pg_hint_moist: Water held in the soil sample.
pg_err_predict: Could not reach the prediction API. Try again when the backend is running.
pg_err_ml_down: The AI service is not running, so no prediction was made. Start it and try again.
pg_err_ml_timeout: The AI service took too long to respond. Please try again.
pg_err_ml_input: Some readings are missing or out of range. Check the values and try again.
pg_err_ml_failed: The AI service could not complete this analysis.
pg_err_backend_down: Could not reach the BharatGrow backend. Try again when it is running.
pg_decision_sub: Crop model, rainfall conditions and mandi prices, scored together.
pg_rain_sub: Rule-based analysis of the live forecast and long-term regional rainfall. Not a rainfall forecast model.
pg_rmkt_sub: Latest published modal price for each recommended crop.
pg_not_saved: This analysis was not saved to your history.
pg_map_p: A blueprint of your plot. Colour comes from live sensor status, not decoration.
pg_map_none_p: Nodes are created from your farm size (one node per 500 m²). Sign in with a farm profile, then wait for the simulator.
pg_map_fail: Could not load the farm map
pg_map_db: Sensor telemetry needs the database to be configured on the server.
pg_map_no_points: No stored readings in this range yet. The graph fills as the simulator writes rows.
pg_az_from_sensors: These values come from persisted node readings. pH and seasonal rainfall are not sensed and stay farmer-entered.
pg_az_sensor_fail: Live sensor readings are not available yet. Wait for the simulator, or enter values yourself.
pg_az_rain_note: Recent rain at the node (informational, not the crop-model rainfall feature)
pg_az_ph_note: No pH sensor on the node. pH is farmer-entered, not sensed.
pg_az_rain_model: Crop-model rainfall is a seasonal total. Leave the slider unset to use today's Open-Meteo forecast. The node rain sensor is not this feature.
pg_hist_alerts_empty: No CRITICAL alerts yet. Average and Bad readings are logged, but only CRITICAL notifies.
pg_email_p: Critical alerts are sent here. Leave blank to use the server fallback.
val_email: Please enter a valid email, or leave it blank.
pg_results_from_model: From the crop model — not invented reasoning.
pg_crop_ai_sub: Existing crop model output for this node's readings. Probabilities are the model's own predict_proba values.
pg_heldout_acc: Held-out test accuracy (training set, not this field)
pg_best_match: Best match for this soil test
pg_hist_try: Try a different crop name or soil quality.
pg_hist_fail_p: Past soil tests could not be loaded.
pg_mkt_p: Know the market before you sell.
pg_mkt_unavail_p: Live mandi data could not be retrieved right now.
pg_mkt_nomatch_p: No official observations matched these filters.
pg_profile_p: Personal information, location, farm, and language stay on this device until you sign out.
pg_more_p: Profile, market, and extra tools — still BharatGrow software, not live sensors.
pg_hw_p: Agricultural alerts stay on this path: sensors → ESP32 / FPGA → thresholds. Phone OTP never fires a field alarm.
pg_hw_sim_note: This page is physical Hardware Beta only. The main app’s farm nodes use simulated software telemetry stored in PostgreSQL — they are not a paired ESP32.
pg_no_tips: The model did not return additional notes for this analysis.
pg_mkt_source: Source: Government OGD / AGMARKNET. Daily Government mandi data. This is not a live ticker. Missing days are left blank.
pg_mkt_detail_p: Latest available mandi price · Daily Government mandi data · Source: Government OGD / AGMARKNET
pg_mkt_one_obs: Only one official observation so far
pg_mkt_signal_wait_p: A 30-day signal appears when enough official mandi days are available.
pg_mkt_missing: Missing Government days are left blank.
pg_mkt_hist_wait: Historical data is still being collected for this period.
pg_mkt_one_line: Only one official observation is available, so a trend line is not drawn.
pg_mkt_obs_none: No official historical points in this window.
pg_mkt_no_compare: No mandi comparison is available for this filter.
pg_mkt_source_foot: Source: Government OGD / AGMARKNET. Latest available mandi price. Arrival dates are official. No estimated prices.
pg_more_profile_d: Farm details, location, language, and sign out.
pg_more_iot_d: Simulated farm nodes, live telemetry, and the field blueprint. Physical ESP32 stays on Hardware Beta.
pg_more_sat_d: Sentinel-ready field view. No fake NDVI as live data.
pg_more_irr_d: Weather-based scheduling when a forecast API is connected.
pg_more_pest_d: Leaf disease diagnosis from an uploaded image.
pg_more_fert_d: Dosing from your soil test — not invented readings.
pg_more_mkt_d: Official AGMARKNET mandi prices — no invented rates.
pg_more_wx_d: Open-Meteo rainfall intelligence + IMD baseline. Not a trained rainfall model.
pg_more_cal_d: Seasonal sowing and growth timeline planner.
pg_more_water_d: Irrigation efficiency when field data exists.
pg_more_esg_d: Sustainability scoring from recorded farm actions.
pg_more_export_d: Downloadable PDFs and CSV from your analyses.
pg_iot_p: Physical sensors → ESP32 → ingest → this screen. Numbers appear only after a real packet arrives.
pg_iot_sim: TELEMETRY · SIMULATED — demo mode. Not physical hardware.
pg_iot_sim_p: Software-generated node readings persist in PostgreSQL every 10 seconds. Physical ESP32 hardware stays on Hardware Beta.
pg_iot_wait_p: Connect your BharatGrow hardware or complete a soil analysis to start seeing field intelligence here.
pg_iot_disc_p: Independent of Fast2SMS login. Threshold LEDs and buzzers stay on the ESP32 / Basys 3 kit.
pg_iot_range_ready: This range is ready. Charts fill from actual timestamps once ingest starts.
pg_ins_fail: Insights could not be loaded. Ensure the ML service is running.
pg_ins_empty: Run analyses to populate this chart.
pg_ins_no_feat: Feature importance from the model is not available yet.
pg_ins_classes_n: crop types supported by the model.
pg_sat_p: Prepared for Sentinel Hub or another imagery API. Field bounds stay empty until a key is wired.
pg_sat_live_nodes: Live farm nodes and simulated telemetry are on IoT Sensors — this page is satellite imagery only.
pg_sat_wait_p: Farm location, boundary, vegetation, and historical comparison will render here when a credential is added on the backend.
pg_sat_tiles: Field boundary and NDVI tiles appear after the satellite API is connected.
pg_wx_p: Rainfall prediction from Open-Meteo forecast plus IMD 1901–2015 subdivision baseline. Rule-based — not a live weather station and not a trained rainfall model.
pg_wx_wait_p: Open-Meteo could not be reached. No invented forecast is shown.
pg_wx_tied_p: This rainfall intelligence informs Analyze, Results, irrigation notes, and SAATHI. Simulated node rain is labelled separately.
pg_wx_source: Weather data provided by Open-Meteo (CC-BY-4.0). Historical baseline from IMD subdivision rainfall 1901–2015.
pg_wx_coords_farm: Using farm coordinates from your profile.
pg_wx_coords_default: Farm GPS is not set — using Indore demo coordinates (22.72°N, 75.86°E).
pg_cal_model_note: The crop model recommends a crop class. This calendar is the existing seasonal planner, not generated by the model.
pg_cal_no_timeline: No calendar timeline exists for that crop.
pg_gis_p: Explore soil regions and crop suitability across India. Hardware nodes stay on Map.
pg_gis_pick_p: Click a state on the map, or search by name. Districts load when that layer is on.
pg_gis_district_soil: District soil is not mapped separately. The state’s dominant ICAR–NBSS group is shown.
pg_gis_no_agri: No agricultural attributes are joined for this boundary.
pg_gis_bound_fail: State boundaries could not be loaded.
pg_gis_dist_fail: District boundaries could not be loaded.
